title: Protocol for induction and characterization of microglia extracellular traps in murine and human microglia cells
protocol: Plate 2 × 10^4 BV2 cells into two well chamber slide or 2 × 10^5 cells in 6-well plate as needed for the experiment.
Use 1 mL culture medium for two well chamber slides and 2 mL culture medium for 6-well plate.
Incubate the cells 12 h–16 h at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Treat cells with 250 μM of dopamine dissolved in water (Stock concentration = 20 mM) and incubate for 24 h at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Discard the medium and wash the cells two times with 1 × PBS for 5 min.
Fix the cells with 500 μL 4% PFA prepared in 1 × PBS for 10 min at room temperature (RT; 20°C–25°C).
Use gloves and protective glasses while preparing formaldehyde.
Wash cells two times with 1 × PBS for 5 min.
Permeabilize cells with 500 μL of 0.1% Triton X-100 (prepared in 1 × PBS) for 15 min at room temperature.
Block cells with 500 μL of 5% FBS in 0.1% Triton X-PBS (Blocking Buffer) for 1 h at 4°C in a humidified chamber.
Add 500 μL of 1:250 dilution of MPO primary antibody prepared in blocking buffer in the marked chambers and incubate 12 h–16 h at 4°C in a humidified chamber.
Discard primary antibody and wash cells two times with 1 × PBS for 5 min.
Tilt chamber slides carefully and aspirate supernatant slowly using a pipette to avoid detachment of cells.
Add 500 μL of 1:1000 dilution of anti-rabbit secondary antibody prepared in blocking buffer in each chamber and incubate at room temperature for 1 h in the dark.
Discard secondary antibody and wash cells two times with 1 × PBS for 5 min.
Dry slides and mount them with VECTASHIELD mounting medium containing DAPI.
Keep the slides at 4°C for 10 min to allow coverslips to settle properly.
Add 10 U/mL DNase I to media in the wells to digest the traps.
Mix well and incubate at RT for 15 min.
Stop the reaction by adding 5 nM EDTA.
Mix well and collect supernatants in clean microfuge tubes.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min at RT to get rid of cell debris.
Transfer supernatant into clean microfuge tubes.
Keep them on ice until ready.
Add 200 μL of collected supernatant in 96-well plate.
Add 5 μM SYTOX Green to the wells.
Incubate for 15 min at room temperature in the dark.
Measure fluorescence using a plate reader at excitation/emission = 485 nm/530 nm.
Seed 10,000 cells per well in duplicates in a 96-well microtiter plate.
Incubate for 12h–16 h at 37°C in 5% CO2.
Add 20 μM of (2′,7′-Dichlorofluorescin diacetate) DCF-DA and incubate at 37°C in 5% CO2 for 30 min.
Discard the culture media and wash cells once with 1 × PBS.
Be gentle with pipetting during washing.
Add 100 μL of fresh culture medium to each well.
Treat cells with 10 mM NAC for 3 h at 37°C in 5% CO2.
Treat cells with 250 μM of dopamine for 24 h at 37°C in 5% CO2.
Measure fluorescence at excitation/emission =485 nm/Em=535 nm.
Treat cells with N-acetyl-L-cysteine (NAC) or cytochalasin D (CytoD) as required by the experiment to check dependency on ROS or actin polymerization.
Plate 2 × 10^4 BV2 cells into two well chamber slides or plate 2 × 10^5 cells in a 6-well plate, using 1 mL culture medium for each slide and 2 mL for the 6-well plate.
Incubate cells at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 12h–16 h.
Treat cells with 10 mM NAC for 3 h or 10 μM CytoD for 20 min, then incubate at 37°C in 5% CO2.
Treat cells with 250 μM dopamine and incubate at 37°C in 5% CO2 for 24 h.
Perform ICC on cells from the two well chamber slides for staining of extracellular traps as explained in step 3 of induction and identification of extracellular traps section, then take images.
Incubate cells with FITC tagged Escherichia coli to check functionality of the traps.
Mix 40 μL of FITC tagged E. coli from Vybrant Phagocytosis Assay Kit to the wells.
Incubate for an additional 21 hours at 37°C in 5% CO2.
Perform ICC on cells in two well chamber slides for staining of the traps as explained in step 3 of induction and identification of extracellular traps section.
Take images.
Seed 10,000 cells per well in duplicates in a 96-well microtiter plate.
Incubate at 37°C in 5% CO2 for 12–16 hours.
Treat the cells with 250 μM of dopamine and incubate at 37°C in 5% CO2 for 24 hours.
Remove the media carefully from the wells.
Add 100 μL of fresh serum-free media to each well.
Add 10 μL of 5 mg/mL MTT (prepared in 1 × PBS) to each well.
Incubate at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 2 hours.
Add 100 μL of acidic isopropanol to each well.
Mix properly.
Measure the absorbance at 570 nm using a plate reader.
Wash the 5 micron thick paraffin embedded tissue section slides with xylene.
Rehydrate slides through decreasing concentration of alcohol: wash with 100% ethanol, then 95%, then 70%, and finally with 1 × PBS.
Mark around the tissue using ImmEdge Hydrophobic Barrier PAP Pen.
Permeabilize the tissue with permeabilizing buffer (0.1% Triton X-100 in 1 × PBS) for 15 min at room temperature.
Remove the permeabilization buffer and stain with Ricinus communis agglutinin-1 (RCA) (1:500 prepared in permeabilizing buffer) at 37°C for 1 h.
Block the samples with 5% FBS in 0.1% TritonX-PBS (Blocking Buffer) for 1 hour at 4°C in a humidified chamber.
Add 1:1500 dilution of Anti DNA/Histone H1 primary antibody prepared in blocking buffer to the marked chambers and incubate 12-16 hours at 4°C in humidified chamber.
Wash the slides three times with 1× PBS for 5 minutes each in different coplin jars.
Add 1:500 dilution of anti-mouse secondary antibody to the slides and incubate them for 1 hour at 37°C in dark.
Wash the slides three times with 1× PBS for 5 minutes each in different coplin jars.
Dry the slides and mount them with Fluoroshield containing DAPI.
Keep the mounted slides at 4°C for 10 minutes to allow coverslips to settle properly.
